text: A Psalm. 1 Sing to YHWH a new song, for He has done wonders! His right hand has gained victory for Him, even the arm of His holiness.
YHWH has made known His victory; before the eyes of the nations, He has revealed His righteousness.
He has remembered His kindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.
Shout joyfully to YHWH, all the earth; break forth and cry aloud and sing praises!
Sing praises to YHWH with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody!
With the trumpets and the voice of the shofar, shout joyfully before the face of YHWH the King!
Let the sea roar, and its fullness, the world, and those dwelling in it!
Let the rivers clap the hands; let the hills cry aloud together,
before the face of YHWH—for He is coming to judge the earth! He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with uprightness!
